description: This Java source file defines the ShoppingCategoryController class, which handles web requests related to category pages in an e-commerce web application. It manages displaying categories, subcategories, associated products, and filtering products by manufacturers or other criteria. The class interacts with services for categories, products, manufacturers, and caches, providing endpoints for category browsing and product listing, including support for REST API calls.

classes.name: ShoppingCategoryController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller handling e-commerce category browsing, including category display, subcategory management, product listing, and filtering functionalities.

methods.name: displayCategoryWithReference
methods.description: Handles requests to show a category page with a reference parameter, delegates to the main displayCategory method.

methods.name: displayCategoryNoReference
methods.description: Handles requests to show a category page without a reference parameter, delegates to the main displayCategory method.

methods.name: displayCategory
methods.description: Private method that processes category display, including breadcrumb creation, caching, subcategory and manufacturer retrieval, and rendering.

methods.name: getManufacturersByProductAndCategory
methods.description: Retrieves a list of manufacturers associated with products in a specific category, utilizing caching for optimization.

methods.name: getManufacturers
methods.description: Fetches manufacturer details from the database based on category IDs.

methods.name: getProductsByCategory
methods.description: Counts the number of products within category and its subcategories.

methods.name: getSubCategories
methods.description: Builds a list of subcategories with associated product counts, suitable for display.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: REST endpoint returning all categories of a store, with localization support.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: REST endpoint returning products of a specified category, supporting pagination and category hierarchy.

methods.name: getProductsFilteredByType
methods.description: REST endpoint to fetch paginated products filtered by specific criteria like manufacturer.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Core method to retrieve paginated product list based on category, filters, and store context.
